policy.note: Theory proofs are Agda (source of truth) rechecked in Rocq and Lean. This ledger records, per theorem, the source leg and each recheck leg, with the route, the axioms and the exact commit of the verification receipt.
policy.grade_note: Grades are recorded, not averaged: no percentages (mathesis §6). A grade must be supported by the legs behind it, and the flags in force must be the flags recorded — see .source.flags_provenance.

theorems.statement: The pipeline's information-losing typing operations are instances of the echo-types fiber Echo f y := Sigma A (lambda x -> f x === y): affine weakening (AffineScript linear is below affine) collapses a distinction, has no section, and refinement erasure is non-injective.
theorems.grade_basis: mathesis §5 Grade 3: type-checks in Agda, has not been translated to an independent foundational system. The Rocq and Lean recheck legs required by PROOF-POLICY §2 are recorded here as open.

evidence.checked_by: proof-ci.yml (then the Agda typecheck lane): Agda 2.8.0, --safe --library=nextgen-typing, agda-stdlib v2.3, echo-types b0982c4, absolute-zero f486c29
evidence.note: Recorded, not re-run. This lane examines the §2 recheck legs; the Agda source leg is audited for form and evidence only. Use `just proof-check-agda` to re-typecheck it locally.

flags_provenance.cli_source: scripts/check-proofs.sh, the agda branch (used by `just proof-check-agda`)
flags_provenance.note: safety_flags is the union of what the files declare and what the instrument passes. The gate reads both out of the tree and fails if this record drifts.

source.escape_hatch_evidence: --safe (the compiler refuses postulates, --injective-type-constructors and the other unsafe pragmas) plus scripts/proof-scan-dangerous.sh and the ledger gate's comment-aware escape-hatch scan, both of which run over these files in the same CI lane.

legs.blocker: no Rocq witness exists. PROOF-POLICY §2 requires one: transport the Agda term through Dedukti/Lambdapi (record the statement comparison) or re-prove the statement in Rocq by hand.
no Lean 4 witness exists. PROOF-POLICY §2 requires one and forbids Mathlib; until a released Lambdapi Lean exporter exists the lean leg is re-proved by hand in core Lean.

statement_formal.note: The Agda declarations a Rocq/Lean recheck leg must match. PROOF-POLICY §2 requires the statement comparison to be recorded, so the text here is checked against the file: if the Agda statement moves, this record must move with it or the gate fails.

declarations.name: TP-ECHO-2
declarations.states: affine subtyping is irreversible: there is no section
declarations.type: ¬ (Σ (LEcho affine → LEcho linear) (λ reify → ∀ e → reify (affine-weakening e) ≡ e))

declarations.name: TP-ECHO-3
declarations.type: Σ SurfaceTy (λ s₁ → Σ SurfaceTy (λ s₂ → (erase s₁ ≡ erase s₂) × (s₁ ≢ s₂)))

theorems.grade_deviation: mathesis §5 names the Grade 3 configurations parenthetically: '--safe --erasure', or 'Full --cubical'. This proof is checked under '--safe --without-K --cubical-compatible' — --erasure is not enabled and full --cubical is not used, so neither named configuration is exactly what runs. The grade stays 3 because the result is carried by Agda alone, under --safe, with no postulates and no translation to an independent system; the difference in flags is recorded here rather than paraphrased into the policy's wording.
